comment: Golden vectors for the RunOS session pass. Read by BOTH the Go verifier in sessiongate and the TypeScript verifier in conductor; both must agree on every verdict. Regenerate with: go test ./internal/pass -run TestUpdateVectors -update. The private key seed is a TEST key and signs nothing real.

vectors.name: valid-vm.ssh
vectors.why: a well-formed pass of every kind must verify, and must DECODE to the same values on both sides

vectors.name: valid-vm.serial
vectors.why: a well-formed pass of every kind must verify, and must DECODE to the same values on both sides

vectors.name: valid-vm.vnc
vectors.why: a well-formed pass of every kind must verify, and must DECODE to the same values on both sides

vectors.name: valid-ws.terminal
vectors.why: a well-formed pass of every kind must verify, and must DECODE to the same values on both sides

vectors.name: valid-ws.files
vectors.why: a well-formed pass of every kind must verify, and must DECODE to the same values on both sides

vectors.name: wrong-prefix
vectors.why: the version prefix is inside the signature, so a v2 pass cannot be read as v1

vectors.name: two-segments
vectors.why: a pass has exactly three segments

vectors.name: four-segments
vectors.why: a fourth segment must be refused, not ignored

vectors.name: empty-payload-segment
vectors.why: an empty segment is not a payload

vectors.name: padded-base64
vectors.why: a subprotocol value must be an HTTP token and '=' is not one

vectors.name: standard-alphabet-base64
vectors.why: '+' and '/' are not token characters either

vectors.name: prefix-adjacent-version
vectors.why: a HasPrefix check without the dot accepts runos_pass_v11 and runos_pass_v10

vectors.name: prefix-wrong-case
vectors.why: the prefix comparison is byte exact

vectors.name: prefix-homoglyph
vectors.why: a Cyrillic o in runos, so the comparison cannot be a normalising one

vectors.name: leading-whitespace
vectors.why: header and subprotocol plumbing adds whitespace, and trimming silently is how a lenient parser starts

vectors.name: trailing-whitespace
vectors.why: the same at the other end

vectors.name: noncanonical-base64-tail
vectors.why: Go's RawURLEncoding accepts a non-zero tail and conductor's round-trip does not; without .Strict() the two refuse one input with two codes

vectors.name: oversize-token
vectors.why: the size cap must fire before base64 and long before Ed25519

vectors.name: short-signature
vectors.why: a truncated signature is a transport fault, named as one

vectors.name: bad-signature
vectors.why: a flipped signature byte must not verify

vectors.name: payload-tampered
vectors.why: changing the payload after signing must not verify

vectors.name: unknown-kid
vectors.why: a kid the gate does not hold is refused without naming the keys it does hold

vectors.name: kid-wrong-length
vectors.why: kid is exactly 16 lowercase hex characters

vectors.name: kid-uppercase
vectors.why: an uppercase kid would be a second name for one key

vectors.name: payload-not-object
vectors.why: a JSON array is valid JSON and not a pass body

vectors.name: payload-null
vectors.why: bare null is valid JSON and not a pass body

vectors.name: payload-trailing-content
vectors.why: bytes after the object were signed and never read

vectors.name: unknown-field
vectors.why: an unknown field is refused, which is what stops a smuggled port

vectors.name: unknown-field-in-vm
vectors.why: and inside the target block too

vectors.name: duplicate-key
vectors.why: two parsers may keep different values for a duplicated key; refuse the shape

vectors.name: missing-field
vectors.why: every field is required

vectors.name: wrong-version
vectors.why: a version 2 body under a v1 prefix

vectors.name: unknown-kind
vectors.why: a kind the gate does not implement

vectors.name: sub-non-ascii
vectors.why: a homoglyph subject is a second identity for one person

vectors.name: exp-fractional
vectors.why: 1755800060.0 is one number in JavaScript and another in Go

vectors.name: exp-exponent
vectors.why: 1.75580006e9 is the same trap in another spelling

vectors.name: exp-string
vectors.why: a quoted number is not a number

vectors.name: iat-negative
vectors.why: a negative issue time

vectors.name: exp-huge
vectors.why: an exp beyond int64 seconds

vectors.name: iat-string
vectors.why: and the same trap on iat, which Go accepted into a json.Number until this vector

vectors.name: exp-leading-zero
vectors.why: a number with two readings has no place in a credential

vectors.name: exp-plus-prefix
vectors.why: a leading plus is legal in some parsers and not in JSON

vectors.name: expired
vectors.why: exp in the past, beyond the skew allowance

vectors.name: not-yet-valid
vectors.why: iat in the future, beyond the skew allowance

vectors.name: exp-equals-iat
vectors.why: a pass that expires when it was issued

vectors.name: exp-before-iat
vectors.why: an inverted window

vectors.name: lifetime-over-cap
vectors.why: a session pass may live 60 seconds however long it claims

vectors.name: ws-files-lifetime-over-cap
vectors.why: and ws.files 300, not more

vectors.name: clock-skew-tolerated
vectors.why: a pass a few seconds stale still opens, or a fast cluster clock breaks every session

vectors.name: lifetime-exactly-at-cap
vectors.why: the cap is inclusive; an off-by-one here silently shortens every pass

vectors.name: expires-in-one-second
vectors.why: the lower edge of the accept window

vectors.name: both-targets
vectors.why: the interesting version rides a vm block on a ws kind

vectors.name: no-target
vectors.why: a pass with nothing to open

vectors.name: kind-target-mismatch
vectors.why: a vm kind carrying a ws block

vectors.name: ns-kube-system
vectors.why: a signed pass must not be able to name a cluster namespace

vectors.name: ns-traversal
vectors.why: dot-dot in a namespace

vectors.name: ns-gate-namespace
vectors.why: the gate's own namespace is not a VM group

vectors.name: name-subresource-injection
vectors.why: a name that continues the subresource path

vectors.name: name-encoded-slash
vectors.why: an encoded slash is still a slash to something downstream

vectors.name: name-query-injection
vectors.why: a query string appended to the name

vectors.name: name-absolute-url
vectors.why: a name that is a whole URL

vectors.name: name-uppercase
vectors.why: Kubernetes object names are lowercase

vectors.name: name-empty
vectors.why: an empty machine name

vectors.name: ws-svc-injection
vectors.why: the same path injection through a workspace service name

vectors.name: jti-wrong-length
vectors.why: jti becomes a Kubernetes object name and its length is fixed

vectors.name: jti-uppercase
vectors.why: an uppercase jti is not a valid object name, so single-use would silently not apply

vectors.name: jti-not-hex
vectors.why: and it must actually be hex
